reference_spec.heading_separation_definition: signed wrap(base_Link COM XY velocity course minus each retargeted wheel rolling-plane heading)
reference_spec.wheel_heading_definition: world(local +Y wheel axle) crossed with world +Z; independent of axle spin

motion_contract.positions: world Z-up meters, link origins rather than COM
motion_contract.linear_velocities: world-frame original unmerged URDF link COM velocities, m/s
motion_contract.runtime_model_note: Export-model hashes document kinematic provenance, not an actuator/contact contract; apply and audit the shared validation model settings separately.

training_budget.scope: PPO rollout collection only, excluding setup smoke/reset checks

training_domain_randomization.robot_mapping: G1 torso_link -> TRON1 base_Link; joint offset applies only to six position-controlled leg joints

validation_material_interpretation.robot_static_and_dynamic_friction: Both overridden to each recorded mu
validation_material_interpretation.ground_static_and_dynamic_friction: Both overridden to each recorded mu
validation_material_interpretation.combine_mode_evidence: Source-configured average; not an independent runtime combine-flag readback
validation_material_interpretation.bounds_note: Ideal configured average-combine bounds, not independently measured coefficients or exact sampled bucket extrema

com_speed_source: Recorded original-link COM world XY velocity; no position differentiation
wheel_heading_source: Recorded audited kinematic reconstruction: wheel world +Y axle crossed with world +Z; not wheel spin
reference_after_final_knot: Hold last reference knot for pointwise display through t=6.98 s; reference archive itself ends at 6.96 s
limitations: One historical checkpoint, seed and episode per coefficient; descriptive sensitivity, not a statistical failure probability.
Only PhysX training and PhysX evaluation are shown; this is not a sim2sim gap or new matched-DR backend comparison.
Coefficient mu is the recorded validation setting; do not infer an independently measured tire-road effective coefficient.
Low-mu behavior is not strictly monotonic; show all 17 coefficients, not a fitted universal friction threshold.
Speed, headings and contact diagnostics after posture loss do not imply successful upright turning.
The low-mu recordings include posture loss; wheel markings are projected rolling-plane headings, not proof of controlled grounded drifting.
No height, flight, beta or wheel-heading failure gate is used; the XY screen is RMSE > 0.15 m OR peak > 0.30 m over 1.44--4.00 s.
